label: Evade
currentSymbol: none (no ACTION_SIGILS entry; default-outline "dodge" art only on unarmedGuard/unarmedTechnique)
artBrief: One shared Evade stance sprite for every Evade card (Dodge Roll and the rest of Defensive > Evade). A body stepping sideways out of a diagonal sweep, open and asymmetric, not a closed shield. Solid sigil in one ink at the Defend sigil visual weight, so the pair sits together in the action row.

label: Fire
currentSymbol: SCHOOL_SIGILS.fire (school); card-tag rail alias fire->spell shows ACTION_SIGILS.spell

label: Earth
currentSymbol: none (no damage node; SCHOOL_SIGILS.alteration text says "including earth and grounding")
artBrief: Earth is an alteration note: two stacked boulders standing on a ground line, solid. Shares the Alteration ground line so the school reads as one family.

label: Psychic
artBrief: An open eye with a spiral around its pupil, line weight. An eye, not the Illusion lens, so psychic stays distinct from illusion.

label: Weathered
artBrief: A scarf loop wrapped over a snowflake, solid silhouette. Reads as warded against cold. One ink.

label: Frost-Exposed
artBrief: The six-spoke Frost snowflake with one spoke broken by a jagged gap, line weight. Derives from the Frost school sigil so the family reads.

label: Unraveled
artBrief: A spiral with a dark centre ring broken on one side, line weight. Derives from the Madness and Insanity family of marks.

label: Rallying Standard
artBrief: A banner on a pole with a swallowtail flag, solid. Uses the card-icon banner silhouette so the card and the status match.

label: Rallying Standard+
artBrief: The Rallying Standard banner with a second pennant on the pole, solid. Same family as the Standard.

label: Unbreakable
artBrief: A solid hexagonal bulwark plate with one horizontal bar inside it, solid. One ink. Unbreakable+ adds a second bar.

label: Unbreakable+
artBrief: The Unbreakable plate with a second inner bar, same silhouette so the pair reads as one family at 24 px. One ink.

label: Goreblood
artBrief: A chalice with one drop falling from its rim, solid. A blood pact without a crown, distinct from the crown glyph.

label: Starstone Charge
artBrief: A faceted four-sided gem with a small spark at its centre, solid. The Starstone family mark.

label: Stargazer
artBrief: A telescope on a tripod pointed up at one star, line weight. One ink.

label: Astral Armor
artBrief: A four-point star inside a ring of dots, solid. Distinct from the Invulnerability bubble.

label: Constellation
artBrief: Three dots joined into a triangle by thin lines, line weight. One ink.

label: Azure Coil
artBrief: A spiral of two loops ending in a small wave, line weight. One ink.

label: Waxing Moon
artBrief: A gibbous moon with its lit side solid and the dark side in outline, line weight. One ink.

label: Moonlit Shield
artBrief: A shield outline with a crescent cut out of its face, solid. One ink.

label: Astromancer
artBrief: An open book with a star above it, line weight. One ink.

label: Thorn Halo
artBrief: A ring of six thorns around a circle, line weight. One ink.

label: Communion
artBrief: A dove with one wing raised above a cup, line weight. One ink.

label: Life Tithe
artBrief: A small urn with a cross on its face, solid. One ink.

label: Zealotry
artBrief: A flame with a lightning notch in its tip, solid. One ink.

label: Ember Tide
artBrief: Three wavy lines rising from an ember dot, line weight. One ink.

label: Harbinger of Blight
artBrief: A dark bloom with one drop falling from its centre, solid. Distinct from the Regen leaf.

label: Blood Unction
artBrief: A small oil flask with a drop leaving its neck, solid. Marks extra bleed on hits.

label: Iron Vow
artBrief: Two chain links crossed with a short bar, solid. One ink.

label: Shieldwall Echo
artBrief: Two overlapping shield outlines, the back one dashed, line weight. Echoes the Unbreakable plate.

label: Prepared
artBrief: A wound coil spring with one notch at the top, solid. Reads as readiness held in reserve. One ink.

label: Venom
artBrief: A single drop with a fang notch cut into its side, solid. Distinct from the Bleed blood drop.

label: Afterimage
artBrief: A figure outline with two faint ghost outlines behind it, line weight. One ink.

label: Deadly Tempo
artBrief: An hourglass with a music note beside it, line weight. One ink.

label: Opportunist
artBrief: A dagger with a small arrow beside its point, solid. One ink.

label: Envenom
artBrief: A curved fang on a short hilt bar, solid. Marks attacks that carry venom.

label: Glass Cannon
artBrief: A cracked diamond with a small burst at its top, solid. One ink.

label: Magic Vulnerable
artBrief: A split circle with a crack running down the middle, line weight. Reads as magic broken open. One ink.

label: Chilled
artBrief: A three-spoke snowflake with a notch on each arm, line weight. Smaller and simpler than the six-spoke Frost school sigil.

label: Sleep
artBrief: A crescent moon with three small dashed Z marks beside it, line weight. One ink.

label: Paralysis
artBrief: A bolt with a broken centre set inside a ring, solid. The ring and the gap say locked, which separates it from plain Lightning.

label: Dazed
artBrief: Three small stars spiralling round a centre dot, line weight. Reads as disorientation. One ink.

label: Off Balance
artBrief: A figure with one foot forward and both arms out, tipping, line weight. Reads as lost footing. One ink.

label: Prone
artBrief: A short down-arrow above a flat ground line with a figure lying on it, solid. One ink.

label: Grounded
artBrief: An earthing symbol: a T-stem dropping into a short ground line, line weight. Use the same ground line as the Alteration sigil.

label: Invulnerability
artBrief: A closed bubble with a hairline inner ring and a centre dot, line weight. The bubble absorbs one hit. One ink at sigil scale.

label: Decoy
artBrief: Two overlapping figure outlines, the back one dashed and fainter, line weight. Reads as a double. One ink.

label: Concealed
artBrief: A hood outline over a half-closed eye, the edge dashed to read as blurred. Line weight. One ink.

label: Exhaust
artBrief: A small hourglass with its lower bulb empty, solid. Card-facing marker for Exhaust.

label: Ethereal
artBrief: A ghost wisp outline with its tail split in two and a dashed edge, line weight. One ink.

label: Innate
artBrief: A half sun over a horizon with three rays, line weight. One ink.

label: Retain
artBrief: A cupped hand holding a small card, line weight. One ink.

label: Unplayable
artBrief: A padlock, solid. Card-facing marker for Unplayable.

label: SP (stamina)
currentSymbol: no resources.js row; staminaOrb draws sapphire orb; UI icon stamina

label: Ward
currentSymbol: glyph ✧ (text); engravedIcon(ward) finds no set member
artBrief: Ward is a magical reserve: a round solid disc with a three-point crest cut out of its centre. Round, not kite-shaped, so it never reads as Block. One ink.

label: Barrier
artBrief: Barrier is a battlefield effect: a half-ring of three curved bars standing on a ground line, line weight, open at the bottom. One ink. Distinct from the Ward disc.

label: AR (Attack rating)
artBrief: Attack rating: a short blade tip pointing up-right with one crossguard notch, solid. Reads as a blade at 24 px. Not the Attack sigil, which has several blades.

label: DR (Defence rating)
artBrief: Defence rating: an outlined kite shield with one bar across its middle, line weight. Outlined and barred so it differs from the solid Block shield.

label: PR (Power rating)
artBrief: Power rating: three rising bars with an up-arrow over the tallest, solid. One ink. Distinct from the Strength arrow glyph.
